description: This file defines the Precision class from the Apache Commons Math library, providing utilities for comparing floating-point numbers with various tolerances, handling special cases like NaN, infinities, and rounding modes.

classes.name: Precision
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for comparing floating-point numbers with various tolerances, handling special cases like NaN, infinities, and rounding modes.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two doubles within a given epsilon, returning 0 if approximately equal, -1 if less, and 1 if greater.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two doubles within a specified number of ULPs (Units in the Last Place).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two floats are equal within a ULP of 1.

methods.name: equalsIncludingNaN
methods.description: Checks if two floats are equal or both are NaN.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two floats are approximately equal within a given number of ULPs.

methods.name: equalsIncludingNaN
methods.description: Checks if two floats are approximately equal within a given number of ULPs or both NaN.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two doubles are approximately equal within a ULP tolerance.

methods.name: equalsWithRelativeTolerance
methods.description: Checks if two doubles are approximately equal within a relative error tolerance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two doubles are equal or within a specified absolute error.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a double to a specified number of decimal places using HALF_UP mode.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a double to a specified number of decimal places with a given rounding mode.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a float to a specified number of decimal places using HALF_UP mode.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a float to a specified number of decimal places with a specified rounding mode.

methods.name: roundUnscaled
methods.description: Helper method that performs rounding using different modes, based on BigDecimal rounding rules.

methods.name: representableDelta
methods.description: Computes a delta value close to the originalDelta so that adding it to x results in a machine-representable number.
